Engineering with purpose.

I’m Maryam Ataee, a civil and environmental engineer with experience in industrial project engineering, project management, and environmental strategy.

My work has included coordinating project schedules and resources, supporting equipment installation and production improvements, preparing technical reports, and contributing to environmental policy, climate resilience, and sustainable resource management.
